raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ st up, memasang sst ala kadar: they ~ged up a temporary shelter for the wounded, mereka memasang tempat teduh sementara ala kadar bagi orang-orang yg cedera; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ so. out (/in, with/), memberikan ( approp n ) kpd: the school will ~ you out with uniforms and books, sekolah itu akan memberikan pakaian seragam dan buku kpd kamu; be ~ged out, memakai: they were ~ged out in fancy dress, mereka memakai pakaian beragam; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vt 1. fit with masts, sails, etc, melengkapi [kapal] (dgn + approp n ): the yatch must be ~ged with new sails, kapal layar itu mesti dilengkapi dgn layar baru; 2. manipulate fraudulently, memanipulasi, melakukan penipuan dlm: they were accused of ~ging the election, mereka dituduh memanipulasi pilihan raya itu; persons guilty of ~ging the share market, orang-orang yg bersalah melakukan penipuan dlm pasaran saham; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. machinery etc for a specific purpose, rig; oil-~, pelantar minyak; 2. ( colloq ) dress, outfit, baju: a bizarre ~, baju yg ganjil; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
